text:
olivia_csm: Heads-up — SignalFlow renewal hits the calendar in ~6 weeks. Customer is asking to shorten to a 9mo term and add 12 seats. Need to sync on pricing impact and PO path.
sam_saleseng: thanks olivia. do we have the current committed seats + effective date? quick numbers help pricing.
olivia_csm: current: 40 seats, renewal date 2026-05-15. customer wants +12 immediately on renewal, preferring 9mo (they're mid-fiscal). worried about pro-rata math.
maria_success: flagged potential onboarding bandwidth. if seats go live at renewal we'll need two extra enablement sessions. can we include that in the SOW?
amanda_fin: procurement asked for vendor code and net60 terms. also they want invoice split by entity (SignalFlow EU / SignalFlow US).
jordan_legal: quick legal: if term is <12mo we need to confirm discount eligibility. also the EU entity will trigger data-residency addendum — does the product use different endpoints? @harry_ops
harry_ops: product note: hosted API in eu-west available, no config change. for Private deployments we'd need extra steps. for hosted, just update billing entity.
sam_saleseng: pricing rec: for 9mo shorten, recommend 7% discount vs 12mo list. add seat ramp credit for the 12 new seats prorated. ok with legal? @jordan_legal
jordan_legal: 7% sounds fine but need to add clause for early termination refund calculation. i'll draft a quick amendment.
olivia_csm: procurement needs a PO template. Amanda, can you confirm vendor code and if the EU entity needs separate contract? If so we'll route two docs.
amanda_fin: vendor code: VF-8742. EU entity: yes, separate billing entity. prefer two POs, one per entity. net60 on both.
docusign-bot: Delivery error to recipient signalflow-eu@invalidemail.com — recipient email mismatch. Please confirm signer emails.
omlivia_typo: (typo) meant olivia_csm above^^
olivia_csm: thanks docusign-bot — SignalFlow provided updated signer list in email thread. i'll push corrected addresses into DocuSign by EOD.
maria_success: scheduling note — can we run two 30-min enablement syncs post-sign? proposed dates 2026-05-18 and 2026-05-20. I'll create calendar invites after we have final seat list.
sam_saleseng: action items:
- olivia: update DocuSign with corrected signer emails (due today)
- jordan: draft 9mo amendment + early termination refund clause (due 48h)
- amanda: prepare two POs with vendor code and entity split (due 48h)
- harry: confirm no infra changes for hosted EU (done)
- maria: schedule enablement sessions once signed
olivia_csm: pinging legal and finance on priority. i'll also add the pro-rate calc here:
```
pro_rate = (monthly_list_price * added_seats) * (months_remaining / 12)
applied_discount = pro_rate * 0.07
```
sam_saleseng: perfect. if we can get sign by 2026-05-10 we can keep onboarding timeline.
jordan_legal: i'll post the draft amendment in this thread when ready.
amanda_fin: prepping POs now — will attach final files to thread.
maria_success: noted — will prep enablement checklist and SMEs.
olivia_csm: thanks team. i'll update the customer (SignalFlow) with the timeline: sign target 5/10, enablements 5/18 + 5/20, finance sends invoices net60. any blockers speak up.
sam_saleseng: no blockers from sales. :thumbsup:
jordan_legal: will likely need one small redline on clause 6.2 — posting draft soon.
amanda_fin: uploaded PO drafts: SignalFlow-US-PO.pdf, SignalFlow-EU-PO.pdf (links in email). attaching here for record.
olivia_csm: received. closing loop — will update thread after DocuSign success. :rocket:
